description: A librarian's cryptographic attestation that a reader completed a book for a reading list. The stamp lives in the librarian's repository, proving authority.

main.description: A completion attestation issued by a librarian

book.description: AT-URI of the reader's book record. Lexicon-agnostic: works with bond.biblio.book, buzz.bookhive.book, or any future book lexicon.

list.description: AT-URI of the reading list this stamp is for
